name: Mohamed Soueilem
summary: Senior Software Engineer with more than seven years of full-stack experience, specializing in scalable software solutions, performance optimization, and cross-functional team leadership. Proven track record of mentoring junior engineers, owning end-to-end projects, and aligning development with business goals. Experienced in Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD environments, with a strong focus on code quality, delivery speed, and engineering excellence.

experience.title: Software Engineer II
responsibilities: Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain clean, maintainable, and efficient software solutions using DevOps model in collaboration with Product Management.
Participate in design reviews and architectural design of new features and systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

Review code by other developers and provide feedback to ensure that code adhered to best practices like coding guidelines, elegant, efficient and maintainable code, with observability built from ground up.
Build testable software, define tests, participate in testing, and automate tests using tools (e.g., Junit, Selenium) and Design Patterns that are guided by test automation pyramid.
Triage defects or customer reported issues; debug and resolve in a timely and efficient manner.
Contribute to maintaining health and quality of services; promptly identify and escalate issues. Utilize health indicators and telemetry for action.
Assist in conducting root cause analysis and implementing measures to prevent future recurrences.
Properly document new product features, enhancements, or fixes. Contribute to training materials.

experience.title: Founder & Owner
responsibilities: Rebuilt the company from the ground up—establishing operations, recruiting interns, and developing a self-sufficient team.
Took full ownership of Lebjawi Tech and transitioned it from a student-run side project to a registered IT company with over 30+ full-time interns.
Recruited, trained, and mentored a diverse team of interns across software development, UI/UX, and digital marketing — helping them build real-world, production-level experience.

experience.title: Software Developer
responsibilities: Developed and maintained accessible, standards-compliant HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for front-end deployment.
Mentored seven junior developers, introducing code standards, documentation, and pair programming.
Upgraded deprecated Chrome extension to Manifest V3, enhancing functionality and compatibility; refactored legacy JS to TypeScript, reducing runtime errors by 20%.
